content:
After an unusually long three-week wait, Apple today released iOS 27 beta 5, bringing fresh icon designs for several apps including Siri and Safari.

Apple redesigns app icons in iOS 27 beta 5

iOS 27 is getting closer to its official release, expected next month.

This beta 5 includes a number of user-facing changes, paving the way for the official launch.

Among them, several built-in apps have received new icons:

  • Siri
  • Safari
  • Preview
  • Settings
  • Remote

You can see some of the new icons in the image above, while other apps have also received minor updates.

Since the first beta, iOS 27 has been gradually introducing changes to its icon design, with Apple continuing to refine last year's Liquid Glass aesthetic.

Since iOS 27 beta testing began, apps such as Maps, Photos and Wallet have already received new icons. However, the changes in this beta 5 show that Apple has not yet finished its icon adjustments for iOS 27.

What do you think of the latest app icon changes in iOS 27? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
